name: memarium-plugin
description: Memarium Claude Code plugin — digest sessions into a per-project typed Memory OS (episodic / semantic / procedural / core, entity wiki, Q&A), recall it before work. Standalone, no extra CLI required. For cross-device sync, see the memarium npm CLI (separate package).

plugins.name: memarium
plugins.description: /memarium digests sessions into typed memory (episodic / semantic / procedural / core) + an entity wiki + distilled Q&A. A SessionStart hook auto-injects the project primer so a new session starts already knowing the project. /memarium-context for deeper recall + entities + past Q&A; /memarium-recall to rank + surface relevant memory for a task.
